decisions.reason: The candidate already requires matching help text in both the label and field; the source confirms that this duplication is acceptable without changing its state.
Displaying placeholder text before activation remains compatible with automatically clearing that text when the field is activated.
The decision about visible placeholder text does not alter preservation of Title-field formatting.
The source selects a visual cue for fillable fields but does not replace or narrow the requirement for a robust alternative to password-dependent legacy fields.
Visible in-field placeholder text does not change the calendar-style date input method.
The source concerns visibility of empty fillable fields and does not change the checklist control type.
The source concerns placeholder visibility and does not change the Bestyrelsesmode dropdown control.
The visual appearance of fillable-field placeholders is unrelated to bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, or variants.
The placeholder cue decision does not alter the required legacy-content migration workflow or copy-paste stability criteria.
The source does not address list-level transitions, Tab behavior, hierarchy structure, or the existing ambiguity about the style ribbon.
The decision to retain visible in-field text does not change style prefixes, naming language, or covered style categories.
The source decision about fillable-field text visibility does not affect inclusion of the required theme colors.
